name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acromegaly_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acromegaly_now@@newly_diagnosed
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's diagnosis of acromegaly is newly established (recent onset).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's diagnosis of acromegaly is newly established (recent onset as per protocol definition).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's diagnosis of acromegaly is not newly established (not recent).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis of acromegaly is newly established.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_somatotroph_adenoma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of somatotroph adenoma (growth hormone-secreting macroadenoma).

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of somatotroph adenoma (growth hormone-secreting macroadenoma).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of somatotroph adenoma (growth hormone-secreting macroadenoma).

name: patient_is_previously_untreated
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is previously untreated for the relevant condition.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has not received any prior treatment for the relevant condition.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has received any prior treatment for the relevant condition.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has received any prior treatment for the relevant condition.

name: growth_hormone_nadir_value_recorded_during_standard_75g_2hr_ogtt_withunit_micrograms_per_liter
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's growth hormone nadir in micrograms per liter, as measured during a standard 75-gram, 2-hour OGTT.
when_unknown: Set to null if the value is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the measured value of the patient's growth hormone nadir in micrograms per liter, as recorded during a standard 75-gram, 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT).

name: patient_has_undergone_glucose_tolerance_test_now

name: patient_has_finding_of_pituitary_macroadenoma_now

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a pituitary macroadenoma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a pituitary macroadenoma.

name: patient_has_finding_of_pituitary_macroadenoma_now@@verified_by_pituitary_magnetic_resonance_imaging_scan

name: patient_pituitary_macroadenoma_value_recorded_now_withunit_centimeter
meaning: Numeric value representing the maximum diameter (in centimeters) of the patient's pituitary macroadenoma measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured maximum diameter in centimeters if a measurement is available now for the patient's pituitary macroadenoma.
